notes.title: Release moved to September!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

We've been running a playtest on Android platform with 37 testers at the moment and are receiving extremely valuable feedback!

Most of it is super positive. Some of the points are also very interesting design challenges and we already have fun ideas to address these feedbacks!
[/p][p]Once this playtest is over, we want to wrap up all the new iterations into a second playtest, but this time for iPhones and iPad.

It is important for us to simultaneous launch the game on all three platforms - and to take the time to read and address important feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore we are taking an extra month to finish up the 1.0 version of LHEA! We are aiming for September 22nd at the moment. Only two months away!


Stay tuned for a lot more updates in the upcoming weeks - things are moving quite fast![/p][p]Jo @ Soul Fuel Games[/p]
